Independent dense-mask and channel fixtures
===========================================

The JavaScript channel reference and literal vectors were authored for this project from the declared arithmetic, without importing any production or prototype implementation. The reference uses BigInt and rounds encoded Rec.709 luma before multiplying by alpha.

Frame fixtures are authored programmatically from the documented 32-byte PRISMA8 frame. High-frequency RGBA fixtures are generated mathematically; no external imagery or license applies to them. The optional photographic integration test uses the separately documented astronaut fixture in ../tonal-color/.
